    Всплывающие уведомления (тосты).
    Живут в отдельном ScreenGui поверх окон, складываются в стопку,
    автоматически исчезают, поддерживают прогресс-бар до закрытия.
]]


local Notify = {}

Notify.History = {}
Notify.MaxHistory = 30
Notify.Queued = {}
Notify.QueueLimit = 5        -- максимум одновременных тостов
Notify.Position = "topright" -- topleft / topright / topleft offset
Notify.Duration = 3.5
Notify.Width = 300
Notify.Enabled = true
Notify.Parent = nil
Notify.Gui = nil

local order = 0

-- ОБЩАЯ стопка тостов. Раньше каждый тост создавал свой приватный список,
-- из-за чего ранее показанные тосты не сдвигались вверх.
Notify.Stack = {}
Notify.Active = {}
Notify.Queued = {}
Notify.History = {}
Notify.Gui = nil
Notify.Position = Notify.Position or "topright"
Notify.Width = Notify.Width or 300
Notify.Duration = Notify.Duration or 3.5
Notify.MaxHistory = Notify.MaxHistory or 30
Notify.QueueLimit = Notify.QueueLimit or 5
Notify.Enabled = true

-- ============================================================
-- РОДИТЕЛЬ
-- ============================================================
local function getParent()
    if Notify.Gui and Notify.Gui.Parent then
        return Notify.Gui
    end

    local parent
    if type(gethui) == "function" then
        local ok, hui = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and hui then parent = hui end
    end
    if not parent then
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    Notify.Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    Notify.Gui.Name = "Ash_Notify_" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
    Notify.Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    Notify.Gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
    Notify.Gui.DisplayOrder = 1000000
    Notify.Gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    Notify.Gui.Parent = parent
    return Notify.Gui
end

-- ============================================================
-- СБОРКА ОДНОГО ТОСТА
-- ============================================================
local function buildToast(options)
    local gui = getParent()
    order += 1

    local accent = options.Color or Theme.Get("Accent")
    local iconText = options.Icon or "•"
    local height = options.Height or 62

    local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
    toast.Name = "Toast" .. order
    toast.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Notify.Width, height)
    toast.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Surface")
    toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    toast.BorderSizePixel = 0
    toast.Visible = false
    toast.ClipsDescendants = true
    toast.Parent = gui
    Instance.new("UICorner", toast).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", toast)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    -- Тень
    local shadow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    shadow.Name = "Shadow"
    shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Notify.Width + 24, height + 24)
    shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-12, -12)
    shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    shadow.Image = "rbxassetid://5554236805"
    shadow.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    shadow.ImageTransparency = 0.55
    shadow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
    shadow.SliceCenter = Rect.new(23, 23, 277, 277)
    shadow.ZIndex = 0
    shadow.Parent = toast

    -- Цветная полоска слева
    local accentBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    accentBar.Name = "AccentBar"
    accentBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -16)
    accentBar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
    accentBar.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    accentBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    accentBar.ZIndex = 3
    accentBar.Parent = toast
    Instance.new("UICorner", accentBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    -- Иконка
    local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    icon.Name = "Icon"
    icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
    icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10)
    icon.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    icon.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
    icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
    icon.Text = iconText
    icon.TextColor3 = accent
    icon.TextSize = 13
    icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    icon.ZIndex = 3
    icon.Parent = toast
    Instance.new("UICorner", icon).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    -- Заголовок
    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Name = "Title"
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 18)
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 8)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = options.Title or "Уведомление"
    title.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    title.TextSize = 12
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    title.ZIndex = 3
    title.Parent = toast

    -- Описание
    local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    message.Name = "Message"
    message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 28)
    message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 26)
    message.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    message.Text = options.Message or ""
    message.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    message.TextSize = 10
    message.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    message.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    message.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    message.TextWrapped = true
    message.ZIndex = 3
    message.Parent = toast

    -- Кнопка закрытия
    local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    closeBtn.Name = "Close"
    closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
    closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 7)
    closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    closeBtn.Text = "✕"
    closeBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    closeBtn.TextSize = 10
    closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    closeBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    closeBtn.ZIndex = 4
    closeBtn.Parent = toast
    Instance.new("UICorner", closeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    -- Прогресс до закрытия
    local progressTrack = Instance.new("Frame")
    progressTrack.Name = "ProgressTrack"
    progressTrack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 2)
    progressTrack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0)
    progressTrack.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    progressTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 0.75
    progressTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
    progressTrack.ZIndex = 3
    progressTrack.Parent = toast
    Instance.new("UICorner", progressTrack).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local progressFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    progressFill.Name = "ProgressFill"
    progressFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    progressFill.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    progressFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    progressFill.ZIndex = 4
    progressFill.Parent = progressTrack
    Instance.new("UICorner", progressFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    -- Эффект тени/свечения слева
    local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0)
    glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-20, 0)
    glow.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
    glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    glow.Rotation = 0
    glow.ZIndex = 2
    glow.Parent = toast
    Instance.new("UICorner", glow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    -- =================================================================
    -- ПОЗИЦИОНИРОВАНИЕ (общая стопка)
    -- =================================================================
    local function stackHeight(entry)
        if entry and entry.frame and entry.frame.Parent and entry.frame.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
            return entry.frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
        end
        return entry and entry.height or 62
    end

    local function sideOffset()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vw = (cam and cam.ViewportSize.X) or 1920
        if Notify.Position == "topleft" then
            return 20
        elseif Notify.Position == "center" then
            return math.floor((vw - Notify.Width) / 2)
        end
        return math.floor(vw - Notify.Width - 20)
    end

    -- Целевая позиция для элемента стопки под индексом index
    local function basePosition(index)
        local y = 20
        for i = 1, index - 1 do
            y = y + stackHeight(Notify.Stack[i]) + 8
        end
        return UDim2.fromOffset(sideOffset(), math.floor(y))
    end

    -- Пересобрать позиции всей стопки
    local function relayout(animate, skip)
        for index, entry in ipairs(Notify.Stack) do
            local frame = entry and entry.frame
            if frame and frame.Parent and frame ~= skip then
                local target = basePosition(index)
                if animate then
                    local startX = frame.AbsolutePosition.X
                    local startY = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y
                    Motion.Frame(frame, 0.3, function(t)
                        frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                            startX + (target.X.Offset - startX) * t,
                            startY + (target.Y.Offset - startY) * t
                        )
                    end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })
                else
                    frame.Position = target
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local entry = {frame = toast, height = height}
    table.insert(Notify.Stack, entry)
    table.insert(Notify.Active, toast)

    -- Клик по самому тосту тоже закрывает
    local closing = false
    local function close()
        if closing then return end
        closing = true

        local startX = toast.AbsolutePosition.X
        local startY = toast.AbsolutePosition.Y

        Motion.Frame(toast, 0.28, function(t)
            toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05 + t * 0.95
            title.TextTransparency = t
            message.TextTransparency = t
            progressFill.BackgroundTransparency = t
            toast.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(startX + (Notify.Width + 20) * t, startY)
        end, {
            ease = Motion.EaseFn("inQuad"),
            onDone = function()
                for i = #Notify.Stack, 1, -1 do
                    if Notify.Stack[i] == entry then
                        table.remove(Notify.Stack, i)
                        break
                    end
                end
                for i = #Notify.Active, 1, -1 do
                    if Notify.Active[i] == toast then
                        table.remove(Notify.Active, i)
                        break
                    end
                end
                relayout(true)
                toast:Destroy()
            end,
        })
    end

    -- Свайп/клик по телу
    toast.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
           or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            close()
        end
    end)
    closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)

    closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        closeBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    end)
    closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
        closeBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    end)

    -- Появление: выезжает с края экрана
    local targetPos = basePosition(#Notify.Stack)
    local offscreenX
    if Notify.Position == "topleft" then
        offscreenX = -Notify.Width - 20
    else
        offscreenX = targetPos.X.Offset + Notify.Width + 20
    end

    toast.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(offscreenX), targetPos.Y.Offset)
    toast.Visible = true

    Motion.Frame(toast, 0.4, function(t)
        toast.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            offscreenX + (targetPos.X.Offset - offscreenX) * t,
            targetPos.Y.Offset
        )
        toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05 + (1 - t) * 0.6
    end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outBack", 1.2) })

    -- Прогресс до исчезновения
    local duration = options.Duration or Notify.Duration
    if duration > 0 and not options.Sticky then
        local done = false
        local timer = Motion.Loop(toast, function(_, raw)
            if done then return end
            local p = 1 - raw
            progressFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(p, 0, 1), 1)
            if p <= 0 then
                done = true
                timer.Stop()
                close()
            end
        end, { period = duration })
    else
        progressFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
    end

    -- Живой цвет под тему
    local themeLoop = Motion.Loop(toast, function()
        accentBar.BackgroundColor3 = accent or Theme.Get("Accent")
        icon.BackgroundColor3 = accent or Theme.Get("Accent")
        title.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        message.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        toast.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Surface")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
        progressTrack.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        glow.BackgroundColor3 = accent or Theme.Get("Accent")
    end, { period = 999999 })

    -- История
    table.insert(Notify.History, {
        Title = options.Title or "Уведомление",
        Message = options.Message or "",
        Time = os.time(),
        Color = accent,
    })
    while #Notify.History > Notify.MaxHistory do
        table.remove(Notify.History, 1)
    end

    return {
        Toast = toast,
        Close = close,
        SetColor = function(color)
            accent = color
        end,
    }
end

-- ============================================================
-- ОЧЕРЕДЬ
-- ============================================================
local function enqueue(options)
    Notify.Queued[#Notify.Queued + 1] = options
    if #Notify.Queued > Notify.QueueLimit * 4 then
        table.remove(Notify.Queued, 1)
    end
    return true
end

-- ============================================================
-- ПУБЛИЧНОЕ API
-- ============================================================

--[[
    Основной вызов.
    Notify:New({
        Title    = "Успешно",
        Message  = "Настройки сохранены",
        Duration = 3,          -- 0 = не исчезает само
        Icon     = "✓",
        Color    = Theme.Get("Success"),
        Sticky   = true,       -- не исчезает, пока не закроют
        Callback = function() end,  -- клик по тосту
    })
]]
function Notify:New(options)
    if not Notify.Enabled then return nil end
    options = options or {}

    if type(options.Callback) == "function" then
        local callback = options.Callback
        options = Utils.copy(options)
        options.Callback = nil
        local handle = buildToast(options)
        if handle and handle.Toast then
            -- Спам защиты: клик по тосту вызывает колбэк
            handle.Toast.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    pcall(callback)
                end
            end)
        end
        return handle
    end

    if #Notify.Stack >= Notify.QueueLimit then
        enqueue(options)
        return nil
    end

    local handle = buildToast(options)

    -- Разгружаем очередь, если появилось свободное место
    task.defer(function()
        while #Notify.Stack < Notify.QueueLimit and #Notify.Queued > 0 do
            local nextItem = table.remove(Notify.Queued, 1)
            buildToast(nextItem)
        end
    end)

    return handle
end

-- Быстрые варианты
function Notify:Success(title, message, duration)
    return Notify:New({
        Title = title or "Готово",
        Message = message or "",
        Duration = duration or 2.5,
        Icon = "✓",
        Color = Theme.Get("Success"),
    })
end

function Notify:Error(title, message, duration)
    return Notify:New({
        Title = title or "Ошибка",
        Message = message or "",
        Duration = duration or 4,
        Icon = "✕",
        Color = Theme.Get("Danger"),
    })
end

function Notify:Warning(title, message, duration)
    return Notify:New({
        Title = title or "Внимание",
        Message = message or "",
        Duration = duration or 3,
        Icon = "!",
        Color = Theme.Get("Warning"),
    })
end

function Notify:Info(title, message, duration)
    return Notify:New({
        Title = title or "Инфо",
        Message = message or "",
        Duration = duration or 3,
        Icon = "i",
        Color = Theme.Get("Info"),
    })
end

-- Очистить все активные тосты
function Notify:ClearAll()
    for i = #Notify.Stack, 1, -1 do
        local entry = Notify.Stack[i]
        if entry and entry.frame and entry.frame.Parent then
            entry.frame:Destroy()
        end
    end
    Notify.Stack = {}
    Notify.Active = {}
    Notify.Queued = {}
    return true
end

-- История уведомлений
function Notify:GetHistory()
    local out = {}
    for i = #Notify.History, 1, math.max(1, #Notify.History - Notify.MaxHistory + 1), -1 do
        table.insert(out, Notify.History[i])
    end
    return out
end

function Notify:ClearHistory()
    Notify.History = {}
    return true
end

-- Позиция (сдвигает активные тосты)
function Notify:SetPosition(position)
    Notify.Position = position
    return true
end

return Notify
end)()

--======================================================================
-- FILE: Elements.lua -> Elements  (require stripped: 7, returns Elements)
--======================================================================
local Elements = (function()
--!nonstrict
--[[
    Ash UI v3.0 — Elements
    Библиотека элементов. Каждый элемент — самодостаточный объект с:
        .Frame        — корневой Frame (то, что попадает в layout)
        .SetValue(v)  — программная установка значения
        .GetValue()   — чтение значения
        .Type         — строка-тип ("Toggle", "Slider", ...)
    Элементы подписаны на Theme.OnChange и сами перекрашиваются,
    поэтому смена темы анимирует весь интерфейс.

    Цвета НЕ перезаписываются каждый кадр: цвет применяется один раз,
    а при смене темы — через подписку. Это дешевле и не вызывает "дрожание".
]]


local Elements = {}

local DEFAULT_HEIGHT = 34
local PADDING = 10

-- Счётчик порядка: элементы идут сверху вниз в порядке создания
-- ОБЪЯВЛЕН ВВЕРХУ, иначе функции выше не видят локал (Lua-скоупинг).
local orderState = 0
local function orderCounter()
    orderState = orderState + 1
    return orderState
end

-- Текущий «открытый» раздел: всё, что создаётся после CreateSection,
-- попадает внутрь него (нужно для сворачиваемых разделов)
local currentSection = nil

function Elements.ResetOrder()
    orderState = 0
    currentSection = nil
end

-- Привязать элемент к текущему разделу
local function attachToSection(element)
    if currentSection and currentSection.Frame and currentSection.Frame.Parent then
        table.insert(currentSection.Children, element)
    end
    return element
end

-- Экспорт для ElementsAdvanced.lua
Elements.__attach = attachToSection

-- Хелпер: подписать объект на смену темы
local function onThemeChange(element, applyFn)
    local conn = Theme.OnChange(function()
        if element.Frame and element.Frame.Parent then
            pcall(applyFn)
        else
            -- элемент уничтожен — отписываемся
            if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
        end
    end)
    return conn
end

-- Хелпер: базовая обводка/скругление
local function decorate(frame, transparency, radius)
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = transparency or 0.5
    return stroke
end

-- Хелпер: hover-эффект с плавным tween
local function addHover(button, colorFrom, colorTo, radius)
    button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if button:GetAttribute("AshDisabled") then return end
        Motion.Tween(button, {BackgroundColor3 = colorTo}, 0.15)
    end)
    button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if button:GetAttribute("AshDisabled") then return end
        Motion.Tween(button, {BackgroundColor3 = colorFrom}, 0.15)
    end)
end

-- =====================================================================
-- SECTION
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateSection("Раздел")
    Раздел можно свернуть/развернуть (опция Collapsible).
    Возвращает объект, чтобы прятать/показывать элементы внутри.
]]
function Elements.Section(page, name, options)
    options = options or {}
    local height = options.Height or 22

    local section = Instance.new("Frame")
    section.Name = "Section_" .. tostring(name)
    section.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    section.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    section.BorderSizePixel = 0
    section.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    section.Parent = page

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = "Label"
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = string.upper(tostring(name))
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
    label.TextSize = 9
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.LayoutOrder = 0
    label.ZIndex = section.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = section

    local line = Instance.new("Frame")
    line.Name = "Line"
    line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 1)
    line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0.5, 0)
    line.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Border")
    line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    line.BorderSizePixel = 0
    line.LayoutOrder = 0
    line.ZIndex = section.ZIndex + 1
    line.Parent = section

    local obj = {
        Frame = section,
        Name = tostring(name),
        Collapsed = false,
        Children = {},
        Type = "Section",
    }

    -- Всё, что создаётся после этого раздела, относится к нему
    currentSection = obj

    function obj:GetValue()
        return not obj.Collapsed
    end
    function obj:SetValue(expand)
        if (not obj.Collapsed) == (not expand) then return end
        obj.ToggleCollapse()
    end

    -- Сворачивание
    if options.Collapsible then
        local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        arrow.Name = "Arrow"
        arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, -14, 0.5, -5)
        arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        arrow.Text = "▼"
        arrow.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
        arrow.TextSize = 7
        arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        arrow.ZIndex = section.ZIndex + 2
        arrow.Visible = false
        arrow.Parent = section

        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
        local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
        hit.Name = "Hit"
        hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hit.Text = ""
        hit.AutoButtonColor = false
        hit.ZIndex = section.ZIndex + 3
        hit.Parent = section

        obj.ToggleCollapse = function()
            obj.Collapsed = not obj.Collapsed
            for _, child in ipairs(obj.Children) do
                if child and child ~= section then
                    child.Visible = not obj.Collapsed
                end
            end
            if obj.Collapsed then
                Motion.Tween(arrow, {TextTransparency = 0}, 0.15)
            end
            onThemeChange(section, function()
                label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
                line.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Border")
                arrow.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
            end)
        end

        hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            obj.ToggleCollapse()
        end)
    end

    onThemeChange(section, function()
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
        line.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Border")
    end)

    Registry.AddSection(obj.Name, obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- LABEL
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateLabel("Текст", {Align = "left", Size = 11, Text = "..."})
    Поддерживает форматирование {nil} в начале — например "🔴 {nil} Live".
]]
function Elements.Label(page, text, options)
    options = options or {}
    local height = options.Height or 18
    local align = options.Align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local frame = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    frame.Name = "Label_" .. tostring(text)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Text = tostring(text)
    frame.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    frame.TextSize = options.Size or 11
    frame.Font = options.Font or Enum.Font.Gotham
    frame.TextXAlignment = align
    frame.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page

    -- Поддержка обновления текста из кода
    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Label",
        Text = tostring(text),
    }
    function obj.SetValue(newText)
        obj.Text = tostring(newText)
        frame.Text = obj.Text
    end
    function obj.GetValue()
        return frame.Text
    end

    onThemeChange(frame, function()
        frame.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    end)

    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- BUTTON
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Кнопка",
        Callback = function() end,
        Icon = "⚡",
        Style = "Default" | "Accent" | "Danger",
    })
]]
function Elements.Button(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or DEFAULT_HEIGHT
    local style = config.Style or "Default"

    local frame = Instance.new("TextButton")
    frame.Name = "Button_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Button")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Text = ""
    frame.AutoButtonColor = false
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = "Label"
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Button")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = config.Align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local iconLabel
    if config.Icon then
        iconLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        iconLabel.Name = "Icon"
        iconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
        iconLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -8)
        iconLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        iconLabel.Text = config.Icon
        iconLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        iconLabel.TextSize = 11
        iconLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        iconLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
        iconLabel.Parent = frame
        label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 0)
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
    end

    local applyStyle = function()
        local t = Theme
        if style == "Accent" then
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = t.Get("Accent")
            label.TextColor3 = t.Get("AccentText")
        elseif style == "Danger" then
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = t.Get("Danger")
            label.TextColor3 = t.Get("AccentText")
        else
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = t.Get("SurfaceLight")
            label.TextColor3 = t.Get("Text")
        end
        if iconLabel then
            iconLabel.TextColor3 = (style ~= "Default")
                and t.Get("AccentText") or t.Get("Accent")
        end
        stroke.Color = t.Get("Border")
    end
    applyStyle()
    onThemeChange(frame, applyStyle)

    -- Ховер
    frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if style == "Default" then
            Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceHover"), BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}, 0.15)
        elseif style == "Accent" then
            Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("AccentHover")}, 0.15)
        else
            Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Danger")}, 0.15)
        end
    end)
    frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        applyStyle()
    end)

    -- Нажатие: короткое "вдавливание" + вспышка
    local pressing = false
    frame.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        pressing = true
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.35}, 0.08)
    end)
    frame.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        if not pressing then return end
        pressing = false
        applyStyle()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15}, 0.12)
    end)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Button",
        Callback = config.Callback,
        Clicked = false,
    }

    function obj:SetValue(v)
        -- Button не имеет значения, но поддерживает "включение/выключение"
        obj.Clicked = v and true or false
        frame.Active = obj.Clicked
    end
    function obj.GetValue()
        return obj.Clicked
    end
    function obj.Press()
        Motion.Flash(frame, 0.3, Theme.Get("Accent"))
    end

    frame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        obj.Press()
        if config.Callback then
            pcall(config.Callback)
        end
    end)

    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- TOGGLE
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Функция",
        Default = false,
        Flag = "MyFlag",        -- можно обращаться Registry.GetFlag("MyFlag")
        Callback = function(value) end,
        Keybind = true,         -- показывать биндинг
        Danger = true,          -- красная подсветка
    })
]]
function Elements.Toggle(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or DEFAULT_HEIGHT
    local flag = config.Flag

    local value = config.Default or false

    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        value = Registry.GetFlag(flag)
    end
    if flag then
        Registry.Flags[flag] = value
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Toggle_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Toggle")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.Name = "Hit"
    hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.AutoButtonColor = false
    hit.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    hit.Parent = frame

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = "Label"
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Toggle")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    label.Parent = frame

    -- Переключатель
    local switchTrack = Instance.new("Frame")
    switchTrack.Name = "Switch"
    switchTrack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 18)
    switchTrack.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, -9)
    switchTrack.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("ToggleOff")
    switchTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
    switchTrack.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    switchTrack.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", switchTrack).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Name = "Knob"
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
    knob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 3
    knob.Parent = switchTrack
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    -- Биндинг (справа от свитча) — создаётся отдельным элементом, тут только место
    local bindLabel
    if config.Keybind then
        bindLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        bindLabel.Name = "Bind"
        bindLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 18)
        bindLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0.5, -9)
        bindLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        bindLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        bindLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bindLabel.Text = "..."
        bindLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        bindLabel.TextSize = 9
        bindLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        bindLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
        bindLabel.Parent = frame
        Instance.new("UICorner", bindLabel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
    end

    local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    glow.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    glow.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex - 1
    glow.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", glow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local accentColor = config.Danger and Theme.Get("Danger") or Theme.Get("Accent")
    local enabledVisual = false

    local function applyTheme()
        local on = enabledVisual
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = on and Theme.Get("Text") or Theme.Get("Text")
        switchTrack.BackgroundColor3 = on
            and (config.Danger and Theme.Get("Danger") or Theme.Get("Accent"))
            or Theme.Get("ToggleOff")
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = on
            and Theme.Get("AccentText")
            or Theme.Get("Text")
        glow.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor
        stroke.Color = on and accentColor or Theme.Get("Border")
        if bindLabel then
            bindLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
            bindLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        end
    end
    applyTheme()
    onThemeChange(frame, applyTheme)

    local function setVisual(newValue, animate)
        if newValue == enabledVisual then return end
        enabledVisual = newValue
        applyTheme()

        if animate then
            Motion.Tween(knob, {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newValue and 18 or 2, 2),
            }, 0.22, "quint", "out")

            Motion.Tween(glow, {
                BackgroundTransparency = newValue and 0.9 or 1,
            }, 0.3)

            -- Лёгкий "пульс" при включении
            if newValue then
                Motion.Tween(switchTrack, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 18)}, 0.12, "quad", "out")
                task.delay(0.12, function()
                    if switchTrack.Parent then
                        Motion.Tween(switchTrack, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 18)}, 0.18, "back", "out")
                    end
                end)
            end
        else
            knob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newValue and 18 or 2, 2)
            glow.BackgroundTransparency = newValue and 0.9 or 1
        end
    end

    local function setValue(newValue, fireCallback)
        newValue = newValue and true or false
        if newValue == value then
            setVisual(value, false)
            return
        end
        local old = value
        value = newValue

        if flag then
            Registry.Flags[flag] = value
        end

        setVisual(value, true)
        Config.ScheduleSave()

        if fireCallback ~= false and config.Callback then
            pcall(config.Callback, value, old)
        end
    end

    hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setValue(not value, true)
    end)

    -- Ховер
    hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}, 0.15)
    end)
    hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15}, 0.15)
    end)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Toggle",
        Flag = flag,
        Callback = config.Callback,
        BindLabel = bindLabel,
        GetValue = function() return value end,
    }
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        setValue(newValue, config.FireOnSet)
    end
    function obj.GetBindLabel()
        return bindLabel
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj, "Toggles")
    setVisual(value, false)
    attachToSection(obj)

    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- TEXTBOX
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateTextbox({
        Name = "Поле",
        Placeholder = "введите текст",
        Default = "",
        Flag = "ChatCommand",
        ClearOnFocus = true,
        Callback = function(text) end,
    })
]]
function Elements.Textbox(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or 34
    local flag = config.Flag

    local value = config.Default or ""
    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        value = Registry.GetFlag(flag) or value
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Textbox_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Textbox")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ClipsDescendants = true
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.6

    local iconLabel
    if config.Icon then
        iconLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        iconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
        iconLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -8)
        iconLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        iconLabel.Text = config.Icon
        iconLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        iconLabel.TextSize = 11
        iconLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        iconLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
        iconLabel.Parent = frame
    end

    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Name = "Input"
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(config.Icon and 32 or 20), 1, 0)
    box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(config.Icon and 30 or 10, 0)
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.Text = tostring(value)
    box.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    box.TextSize = 11
    box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    box.Text = ""
    box.PlaceholderText = tostring(config.Placeholder or "")
    box.PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.TextEditable = true
    box.MultiLine = false
    box.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    box.Parent = frame

    -- НЕвидимый лейбл показывает реальное значение (для Keybind/экспорта)
    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Textbox",
        Flag = flag,
        Callback = config.Callback,
        Input = box,
    }

    local focused = false
    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        box.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        box.PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
        stroke.Color = focused and Theme.Get("BorderLight") or Theme.Get("Border")
        if iconLabel then
            iconLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        end
    end
    applyTheme()
    onThemeChange(frame, applyTheme)

    box.Focused:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        applyTheme()
        if config.ClearOnFocus then
            box.Text = ""
        end
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.0}, 0.15)
        if config.OnFocus then pcall(config.OnFocus, box) end
    end)

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        applyTheme()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}, 0.15)
        local newValue = box.Text
        if newValue ~= value then
            value = newValue
            if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = value end
            Config.ScheduleSave()
            if config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value) end
        end
        if config.OnBlur then pcall(config.OnBlur, box) end
    end)

    obj.GetValue = function() return box.Text end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        box.Text = tostring(newValue or "")
        value = box.Text
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = value end
    end
    function obj:SetPlaceholder(text)
        box.PlaceholderText = tostring(text)
    end
    function obj:Focus()
        box:CaptureFocus()
    end
    function obj:Blur()
        box:ReleaseFocus()
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj, "Textboxes")
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- KEYBIND
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateKeybind({
        Name = "Бинд",
        Default = Enum.KeyCode.F,
        Flag = "Bind_F",
        Callback = function(key) end,
        Mode = "Toggle" | "Hold" | "Click",
    })
]]
function Elements.Keybind(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or DEFAULT_HEIGHT
    local flag = config.Flag
    local mode = config.Mode or "Toggle"

    local value = config.Default or Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        local stored = Registry.GetFlag(flag)
        if stored ~= nil then value = stored end
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("TextButton")
    frame.Name = "Keybind_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Keybind")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Text = ""
    frame.AutoButtonColor = false
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = "Label"
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Keybind")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local keyDisplay = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    keyDisplay.Name = "Key"
    keyDisplay.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 20)
    keyDisplay.Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -10)
    keyDisplay.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
    keyDisplay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    keyDisplay.BorderSizePixel = 0
    keyDisplay.Text = "[...]"
    keyDisplay.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    keyDisplay.TextSize = 10
    keyDisplay.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    keyDisplay.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    keyDisplay.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", keyDisplay).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    local function keyToString(key)
        if key == nil or key == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return "NONE" end
        if typeof(key) == "string" then return key:upper() end
        local name = tostring(key)
        return name:match("[^%.]+$") or name
    end

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        keyDisplay.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        keyDisplay.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    end
    applyTheme()
    onThemeChange(frame, applyTheme)

    local listening = false
    local active = false

    local function setValue(newValue, fire)
        value = newValue
        keyDisplay.Text = "[" .. keyToString(newValue) .. "]"
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = newValue end
        Config.ScheduleSave()
        if fire and config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, newValue) end
    end

    -- Ввод с клавиатуры
    local function onKeyDown(input, processed)
        if processed then return end
        if not listening then
            -- Работа бинда
            if mode == "Hold" then
                if input.KeyCode == value then
                    active = true
                    if config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value, true) end
                end
            elseif mode == "Click" then
                if input.KeyCode == value then
                    if config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value) end
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if listening then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                listening = false
                setValue(Enum.KeyCode.Unknown, true)
            elseif input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                setValue(input.KeyCode, true)
            end
            listening = false
        end
    end

    local function onKeyUp(input)
        if mode == "Hold" and active and input.KeyCode == value then
            active = false
            if config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value, false) end
        end
    end

    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed) onKeyDown(input, processed) end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) onKeyUp(input) end)

    frame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        listening = true
        keyDisplay.Text = "[...]"
        keyDisplay.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Warning")
    end)

    frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}, 0.15)
    end)
    frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15}, 0.15)
        keyDisplay.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    end)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Keybind",
        Flag = flag,
        Mode = mode,
        Callback = config.Callback,
        Display = keyDisplay,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return value
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        setValue(newValue, false)
    end
    function obj:GetKey()
        return value
    end
    function obj:IsActive()
        return active
    end

    keyDisplay.Text = "[" .. keyToString(value) .. "]"
    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj, "Keys")
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- STEPPER (счётчик +/-)
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateStepper({
        Name = "Шаг",
        Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = 1, Step = 1,
        Flag = "Step",
        Callback = function(v) end,
    })
]]
function Elements.Stepper(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or DEFAULT_HEIGHT
    local flag = config.Flag

    local minValue = config.Min or 0
    local maxValue = config.Max or 10
    local step = config.Step or 1
    local value = config.Default or minValue

    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        value = Registry.GetFlag(flag) or value
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Stepper_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Stepper")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Stepper")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local valueDisplay = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valueDisplay.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 20)
    valueDisplay.Position = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0.5, -10)
    valueDisplay.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
    valueDisplay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    valueDisplay.BorderSizePixel = 0
    valueDisplay.Text = tostring(value)
    valueDisplay.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    valueDisplay.TextSize = 11
    valueDisplay.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valueDisplay.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    valueDisplay.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", valueDisplay).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    local function makeButton(text, offsetFromRight)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, offsetFromRight, 0.5, -11)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = text
        btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        btn.TextSize = 12
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
        btn.Parent = frame
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
        return btn
    end

    local minusBtn = makeButton("-", -32)
    local plusBtn = makeButton("+", -6)

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        valueDisplay.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        valueDisplay.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        minusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        plusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        minusBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        plusBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    end
    applyTheme()
    onThemeChange(frame, applyTheme)

    for _, btn in ipairs({minusBtn, plusBtn}) do
        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            Motion.Tween(btn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")}, 0.15)
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Motion.Tween(btn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")}, 0.15)
        end)
    end

    local function setValue(newValue, fire)
        newValue = Utils.clamp(newValue, minValue, maxValue)
        newValue = Utils.round(newValue, 2)
        if newValue == value then return end
        value = newValue
        valueDisplay.Text = tostring(value)
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = value end
        Config.ScheduleSave()
        if fire ~= false and config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value) end
    end

    minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setValue(value - step, true) end)
    plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setValue(value + step, true) end)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Stepper",
        Flag = flag,
        Callback = config.Callback,
        Min = minValue, Max = maxValue, Step = step,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return value
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        setValue(newValue, false)
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj)
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

function Elements.orderCounter()
    orderState = orderState + 1
    return orderState
end

return Elements
end)()

--======================================================================
-- FILE: ElementsAdvanced.lua -> Advanced  (require stripped: 7, returns Elements)
--======================================================================
local Advanced = (function()
--!nonstrict
--[[
    Ash UI v3.0 — Elements (продолжение)
    Продвинутые элементы: Slider, Dropdown, Listbox, ColorPicker,
    ProgressBar, Accordion, Paragraph, Tooltip, Camera, Spacer.

    Файл подключается как продолжение Elements (методы добавляются в таблицу).
]]


local Elements = {}

local DEFAULT_HEIGHT = 34
local function orderCounter()
    return Elements.orderCounter()
end

local function attachToSection(element)
    if Elements.__attach then
        Elements.__attach(element)
    end
    return element
end

-- Подписка на смену темы с авто-отпиской при уничтожении элемента
local function subscribe(element, applyFn)
    return Theme.OnChange(function()
        local frame = element and (element.Frame or element)
        if frame and frame.Parent then
            pcall(applyFn)
        end
    end)
end

-- =====================================================================
-- SLIDER
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Скорость",
        Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = 50,
        Step = 1,              -- 0 = плавный (без шага)
        Suffix = "%",
        Flag = "Speed",
        Callback = function(v) end,
    })
    Управление: мышь тянет ползунок, колесо меняет значение, стрелки влево/вправо.
]]
function Elements.Slider(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or 46
    local flag = config.Flag

    local minValue = config.Min or 0
    local maxValue = config.Max or 100
    local step = config.Step or 1
    local suffix = config.Suffix or ""
    local prefix = config.Prefix or ""

    local value = config.Default or minValue
    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        value = Registry.GetFlag(flag)
        if value == nil then value = config.Default or minValue end
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Slider_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Slider")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 16)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Slider")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local valueLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valueLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 16)
    valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 4)
    valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    valueLabel.TextSize = 11
    valueLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valueLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    valueLabel.Parent = frame

    -- Дорожка
    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Name = "Track"
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 6)
    track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0, 1, -14)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
    track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    track.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Name = "Fill"
    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    fill.Parent = track
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Name = "Knob"
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 3
    knob.Parent = track
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knobGlow = Instance.new("Frame")
    knobGlow.Name = "KnobGlow"
    knobGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
    knobGlow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knobGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    knobGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
    knobGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knobGlow.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    knobGlow.Parent = track
    Instance.new("UICorner", knobGlow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.Name = "Hit"
    hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
    hit.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0, 1, -24)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.AutoButtonColor = false
    hit.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 4
    hit.Parent = frame

    local function formatValue(v)
        if config.Format then
            return tostring(config.Format(v))
        end
        local n
        if step >= 1 then
            n = tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
        else
            n = string.format("%.2f", v):gsub("0$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")
        end
        return prefix .. n .. suffix
    end

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        track.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        knobGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    end
    applyTheme()
    subscribe(frame, applyTheme)

    local function updateVisual(animate)
        local ratio = (value - minValue) / (maxValue - minValue)
        ratio = Utils.clamp(ratio, 0, 1)
        valueLabel.Text = formatValue(value)

        local targetFill = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
        local targetKnob = UDim2.new(1, -7, 0.5, 0) -- по X масштаб
        if animate then
            -- Пружина на ширине заливки
            local startRatio = fill.Size.X.Scale
            Motion.Frame(fill, 0.25, function(t)
                fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(startRatio + (ratio - startRatio) * t, 1)
            end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })

            local startKnob = knob.Position.X.Scale
            Motion.Frame(knob, 0.25, function(t)
                knob.Position = UDim2.new(startKnob + (ratio - startKnob) * t, -7, 0.5, 0)
            end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })
        else
            fill.Size = targetFill
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(ratio, -7, 0.5, 0)
        end
    end

    local function setValue(newValue, fire)
        newValue = Utils.clamp(newValue, minValue, maxValue)
        if step and step > 0 then
            newValue = Utils.roundTo(newValue, step)
        end
        if newValue == value then
            updateVisual(false)
            return
        end
        local old = value
        value = newValue
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = value end
        updateVisual(true)
        Config.ScheduleSave()
        if fire ~= false and config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value, old) end
    end

    -- Перетаскивание
    local dragging = false
    local function fromPointer(px)
        local size = track.AbsoluteSize.X
        if size <= 0 then return value end
        local ratio = Utils.clamp(px / size, 0, 1)
        return minValue + ratio * (maxValue - minValue)
    end

    hit.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function(input)
        dragging = true
        Motion.Tween(knob, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)}, 0.12)
        Motion.Tween(knobGlow, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.4}, 0.12)
        setValue(fromPointer(input.Position.X), true)
    end)

    hit.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
           or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            setValue(fromPointer(input.Position.X), true)
        end
    end)

    hit.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        dragging = false
        Motion.Tween(knob, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)}, 0.15, "back", "out")
        Motion.Tween(knobGlow, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.7}, 0.15)
    end)

    hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(knobGlow, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.55}, 0.15)
    end)
    hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(knobGlow, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.7}, 0.15)
    end)

    -- Колесо мыши
    hit.MouseWheel:Connect(function(delta)
        local amount = (maxValue - minValue) * 0.05
        if step and step > 0 then
            amount = step * (delta > 0 and 1 or -1)
        else
            amount = amount * (delta > 0 and 1 or -1)
        end
        setValue(value + amount, true)
    end)

    -- Двойной клик — сброс к дефолту
    if config.ResetOnDoubleClick ~= false then
        hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if (hit.ActiveInputs or 1) >= 2 then
                setValue(config.Default or minValue, true)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Стрелки клавиатуры
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left then
                setValue(value - (step > 0 and step or 1), true)
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right then
                setValue(value + (step > 0 and step or 1), true)
            end
        end
    end)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Slider",
        Flag = flag,
        Callback = config.Callback,
        Min = minValue, Max = maxValue, Step = step,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return value
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        setValue(newValue, false)
    end
    function obj:SetFormat(fn)
        config.Format = fn
        valueLabel.Text = formatValue(value)
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj, "Sliders")
    updateVisual(false)
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- DROPDOWN
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Режим",
        Options = {"A", "B", "C"},
        Default = 1,            -- индекс (1-based) или строка
        Multi = false,          -- мультивыбор через запятую
        Flag = "Mode",
        Callback = function(value) end,
    })
]]
function Elements.Dropdown(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or 34
    local flag = config.Flag
    local options = config.Options or {"None"}
    local multi = config.Multi or false
    local maxVisible = config.MaxVisible or 6

    local function optionText(opt)
        if type(opt) == "table" then
            return opt.Text or opt.Name or tostring(opt)
        end
        return tostring(opt)
    end

    local selected = {}
    local value

    if multi then
        selected = {}
        value = ""
    else
        value = optionText(options[config.Default or 1])
    end

    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        local stored = Registry.GetFlag(flag)
        if stored ~= nil then value = stored end
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Dropdown_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Dropdown")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Dropdown")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local valueLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valueLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 20)
    valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -10)
    valueLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
    valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    valueLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    valueLabel.Text = ""
    valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    valueLabel.TextSize = 10
    valueLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    valueLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    valueLabel.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", valueLabel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, -5)
    arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    arrow.Text = "▼"
    arrow.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    arrow.TextSize = 7
    arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    arrow.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    arrow.Parent = frame

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.AutoButtonColor = false
    hit.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 3
    hit.Parent = frame

    -- Контейнер вариантов (поверх всего, вне layout)
    local listFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    listFrame.Name = "Options"
    listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    listFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, height + 4)
    listFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Surface")
    listFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    listFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    listFrame.Visible = false
    listFrame.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 50
    listFrame.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", listFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local listStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", listFrame)
    listStroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    listStroke.Thickness = 1
    listStroke.Transparency = 0.4

    local listScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    listScroll.Name = "Scroll"
    listScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8)
    listScroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
    listScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    listScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    listScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 2
    listScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    listScroll.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4
    listScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    listScroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    listScroll.ZIndex = listFrame.ZIndex + 1
    listScroll.Parent = listFrame
    Instance.new("UIListLayout", listScroll).Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    Instance.new("UIPadding", listScroll).PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local expanded = false
    local optionButtons = {}
    local hovered = nil

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        valueLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        arrow.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        listFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Surface")
        listStroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
        listScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    end
    applyTheme()
    subscribe(frame, applyTheme)

    local function computeValue()
        if not multi then
            return value
        end
        local parts = {}
        for _, opt in ipairs(options) do
            if selected[optionText(opt)] then
                table.insert(parts, optionText(opt))
            end
        end
        return table.concat(parts, ", ")
    end

    local function updateValueLabel()
        local v = computeValue()
        if v == nil or v == "" then
            valueLabel.Text = config.Placeholder or "Выбрать"
            valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
        else
            valueLabel.Text = v
            valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        end
    end

    local function setValue(newValue, fire)
        value = newValue
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = value end
        updateValueLabel()
        Config.ScheduleSave()
        if fire ~= false and config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value) end
    end

    local function setExpanded(state, animate)
        if expanded == state then return end
        expanded = state

        if state then
            listFrame.Visible = true
            local visibleCount = math.min(#options, maxVisible)
            local targetHeight = visibleCount * 26 + 8

            -- Если список уходит за низ окна — открываем вверх
            local screenPos = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y + frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vh = (cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y) or 1080
            if screenPos + targetHeight > vh - 10 then
                listFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -(targetHeight + 4))
            else
                listFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, height + 4)
            end

            if animate then
                listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                Motion.Frame(listFrame, 0.25, function(t)
                    listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, targetHeight * t)
                end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })
            else
                listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, targetHeight)
            end

            arrow.Text = "▲"
            Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}, 0.15)
        else
            if animate then
                local startH = listFrame.Size.Y.Offset
                Motion.Frame(listFrame, 0.2, function(t)
                    listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, startH * (1 - t))
                end, {
                    ease = Motion.EaseFn("inQuad"),
                    onDone = function()
                        listFrame.Visible = false
                    end,
                })
            else
                listFrame.Visible = false
            end
            arrow.Text = "▼"
            Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15}, 0.15)
        end
    end

    -- Создание кнопок вариантов
    for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
        local text = optionText(opt)
        local rowHeight = 26

        local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
        row.Name = "Option" .. i
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, rowHeight)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Text = ""
        row.AutoButtonColor = false
        row.LayoutOrder = i
        row.ZIndex = listFrame.ZIndex + 2
        row.Parent = listScroll
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

        local rowLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        rowLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
        rowLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0)
        rowLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rowLabel.Text = text
        rowLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        rowLabel.TextSize = 10
        rowLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        rowLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        rowLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        rowLabel.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
        rowLabel.Parent = row

        local check = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        check.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
        check.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0.5, -6)
        check.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        check.Text = "✓"
        check.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        check.TextSize = 10
        check.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        check.Visible = false
        check.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
        check.Parent = row

        table.insert(optionButtons, {
            Frame = row,
            Label = rowLabel,
            Check = check,
            Text = text,
        })

        local function updateRowState()
            local isSelected
            if multi then
                isSelected = selected[text] == true
            else
                isSelected = value == text
            end
            check.Visible = isSelected
            rowLabel.TextColor3 = isSelected and Theme.Get("Accent") or Theme.Get("TextDim")
            row.BackgroundTransparency = isSelected and 0.85 or 1
        end

        row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            hovered = row
            Motion.Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")}, 0.12)
        end)
        row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            hovered = nil
            local isSelected = multi and selected[text] or (not multi and value == text)
            Motion.Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = isSelected and 0.85 or 1}, 0.12)
        end)
        row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if multi then
                selected[text] = not selected[text]
                setValue(computeValue(), true)
            else
                setValue(text, true)
                setExpanded(false, true)
            end
            for _, btn in ipairs(optionButtons) do
                local isSel = multi and selected[btn.Text] or (not multi and value == btn.Text)
                btn.Check.Visible = isSel
                btn.Label.TextColor3 = isSel and Theme.Get("Accent") or Theme.Get("TextDim")
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Закрытие по клику вне
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local function closeIfOutside(input)
        if not expanded then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
        local pos = input.Position
        local p = listFrame.AbsolutePosition
        local s = listFrame.AbsoluteSize
        if pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + s.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + s.Y then
            return -- клик по списку
        end
        local fp = frame.AbsolutePosition
        local fs = frame.AbsoluteSize
        if pos.X >= fp.X and pos.X <= fp.X + fs.X and pos.Y >= fp.Y and pos.Y <= fp.Y + fs.Y then
            return -- клик по самому дропдауну (его обработчик сам переключит)
        end
        setExpanded(false, true)
    end
    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(closeIfOutside)

    hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setExpanded(not expanded, true)
    end)

    hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}, 0.15)
    end)
    hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if not expanded then
            Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15}, 0.15)
        end
    end)

    -- Начальное выделение
    for _, btn in ipairs(optionButtons) do
        local isSel = value == btn.Text
        btn.Check.Visible = isSel
        btn.Label.TextColor3 = isSel and Theme.Get("Accent") or Theme.Get("TextDim")
    end
    updateValueLabel()

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Dropdown",
        Flag = flag,
        Callback = config.Callback,
        Options = options,
        Selected = selected,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return computeValue()
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        if multi then
            for _, btn in ipairs(optionButtons) do
                selected[btn.Text] = false
                btn.Check.Visible = false
            end
            for _, part in ipairs(tostring(newValue):split(",")) do
                local trimmed = part:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                for _, btn in ipairs(optionButtons) do
                    if btn.Text == trimmed then
                        selected[trimmed] = true
                        btn.Check.Visible = true
                    end
                end
            end
            setValue(computeValue(), false)
        else
            setValue(tostring(newValue), false)
            for _, btn in ipairs(optionButtons) do
                local isSel = value == btn.Text
                btn.Check.Visible = isSel
                btn.Label.TextColor3 = isSel and Theme.Get("Accent") or Theme.Get("TextDim")
            end
        end
    end
    function obj:Select(index)
        local opt = options[index]
        if opt then
            obj:SetValue(optionText(opt))
        end
    end
    function obj:Toggle(open)
        setExpanded(open, true)
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj, "Dropdowns")
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- LISTBOX
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateListbox({
        Name = "Игроки",
        Options = {...},
        Multi = true,
        Height = 120,
        Flag = "Targets",
        Callback = function(selectedList) end,
    })
    Список с прокруткой и мультивыбором (удобно для ESP-целей).
]]
function Elements.Listbox(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or 130
    local flag = config.Flag
    local options = config.Options or {}
    local multi = config.Multi ~= false

    local function optionText(opt)
        if type(opt) == "table" then
            return opt.Text or opt.Name or tostring(opt)
        end
        return tostring(opt)
    end

    local selected = {}
    local value = ""

    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
