    elseif flag then
        value = Registry.GetFlag(flag) or ""
    end

    -- Восстановление выделения из сохранённой строки
    if flag and value ~= "" then
        for _, part in ipairs(tostring(value):split(",")) do
            selected[part:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")] = true
        end
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Listbox_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Listbox")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 5)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Listbox")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local countLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    countLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 16)
    countLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 5)
    countLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    countLabel.Text = "0"
    countLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    countLabel.TextSize = 10
    countLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    countLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    countLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    countLabel.Parent = frame

    local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    scroll.Name = "Scroll"
    scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -26)
    scroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 24)
    scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 2
    scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    scroll.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4
    scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    scroll.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    scroll.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UIListLayout", scroll).Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)

    local rows = {}

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        countLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
            row.Label.TextColor3 = selected[row.Text] and Theme.Get("Accent") or Theme.Get("TextDim")
        end
    end
    applyTheme()
    subscribe(frame, applyTheme)

    local function computeValue()
        local parts = {}
        for _, opt in ipairs(options) do
            local text = optionText(opt)
            if selected[text] then
                table.insert(parts, text)
            end
        end
        return table.concat(parts, ", ")
    end

    local function updateCount()
        local count = 0
        for _ in pairs(selected) do count = count + 1 end
        countLabel.Text = tostring(count)
    end

    local function setValue(newValue, fire)
        value = tostring(newValue or "")
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = value end
        updateCount()
        Config.ScheduleSave()
        if fire ~= false and config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, selected, computeValue()) end
    end

    for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
        local text = optionText(opt)
        local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
        row.Name = "Row" .. i
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 24)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Text = ""
        row.AutoButtonColor = false
        row.LayoutOrder = i
        row.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
        row.Parent = scroll
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

        local rowLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        rowLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
        rowLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0)
        rowLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rowLabel.Text = text
        rowLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        rowLabel.TextSize = 10
        rowLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        rowLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        rowLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        rowLabel.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
        rowLabel.Parent = row

        local check = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        check.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
        check.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, -6)
        check.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        check.Text = "✓"
        check.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        check.TextSize = 10
        check.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        check.Visible = false
        check.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
        check.Parent = row

        local entry = {Frame = row, Label = rowLabel, Check = check, Text = text}
        table.insert(rows, entry)
        check.Visible = selected[text] == true

        row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            Motion.Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.85}, 0.12)
        end)
        row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Motion.Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = selected[text] and 0.85 or 1}, 0.12)
        end)
        row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if multi then
                selected[text] = not selected[text]
            else
                for k in pairs(selected) do selected[k] = false end
                selected[text] = true
            end
            for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
                local isSel = selected[r.Text] == true
                r.Check.Visible = isSel
                r.Label.TextColor3 = isSel and Theme.Get("Accent") or Theme.Get("TextDim")
            end
            setValue(computeValue(), true)
        end)
    end

    updateCount()

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Listbox",
        Flag = flag,
        Callback = config.Callback,
        Rows = rows,
        Selected = selected,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return computeValue()
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        for k in pairs(selected) do selected[k] = false end
        for _, part in ipairs(tostring(newValue or ""):split(",")) do
            selected[part:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")] = true
        end
        for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
            local isSel = selected[r.Text] == true
            r.Check.Visible = isSel
            r.Label.TextColor3 = isSel and Theme.Get("Accent") or Theme.Get("TextDim")
        end
        setValue(computeValue(), false)
    end
    -- Добавление пунктов во время работы (например, список игроков)
    function obj:Add(option)
        local text = optionText(option)
        table.insert(options, option)
        local index = #options
        local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 24)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Text = ""
        row.AutoButtonColor = false
        row.LayoutOrder = index
        row.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
        row.Parent = scroll
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

        local rowLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        rowLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
        rowLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0)
        rowLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rowLabel.Text = text
        rowLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        rowLabel.TextSize = 10
        rowLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        rowLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        rowLabel.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
        rowLabel.Parent = row

        local entry = {Frame = row, Label = rowLabel, Check = nil, Text = text}
        table.insert(rows, entry)

        row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            Motion.Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.85}, 0.12)
        end)
        row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            selected[text] = not selected[text]
            setValue(computeValue(), true)
        end)
        return true
    end
    function obj:Remove(text)
        local text = tostring(text)
        for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
            if optionText(opt) == text then
                table.remove(options, i)
                break
            end
        end
        for i = #rows, 1, -1 do
            if rows[i].Text == text then
                local row = rows[i]
                if row.Check then row.Check:Destroy() end
                row.Label:Destroy()
                row.Frame:Destroy()
                table.remove(rows, i)
                break
            end
        end
        selected[text] = nil
        setValue(computeValue(), true)
        return true
    end
    function obj:Clear()
        for i = #rows, 1, -1 do
            local row = rows[i]
            if row.Check then row.Check:Destroy() end
            row.Label:Destroy()
            row.Frame:Destroy()
            table.remove(rows, i)
        end
        options = {}
        for k in pairs(selected) do selected[k] = false end
        setValue("", true)
        return true
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj)
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- COLORPICKER
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateColorPicker({
        Name = "Цвет",
        Default = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
        Flag = "Color",
        Callback = function(color) end,
    })
    Полноценный HSV-пикер: квадрат насыщенности, полоса оттенка, hex-поле.
]]
function Elements.ColorPicker(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local flag = config.Flag
    local height = 96

    local color = config.Default or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, color, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        local stored = Registry.GetFlag(flag)
        if stored then color = stored end
    end

    local hsv = Utils.colorToHsv(color)

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "ColorPicker_" .. tostring(config.Name or "ColorPicker")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 16)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 5)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Color")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local hexLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hexLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 16)
    hexLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 5)
    hexLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hexLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    hexLabel.TextSize = 10
    hexLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    hexLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    hexLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    hexLabel.Parent = frame

    -- Превью
    local preview = Instance.new("Frame")
    preview.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
    preview.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -30)
    preview.BackgroundColor3 = color
    preview.BorderSizePixel = 0
    preview.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    preview.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", preview).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    -- Квадрат насыщенности/яркости
    local sq = Instance.new("Frame")
    sq.Name = "SaturationValue"
    sq.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -46)
    sq.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0, 0, 24)
    sq.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    sq.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sq.ClipsDescendants = true
    sq.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    sq.Parent = frame

    local whiteGrad = Instance.new("Frame")
    whiteGrad.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    whiteGrad.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    whiteGrad.BorderSizePixel = 0
    whiteGrad.ZIndex = sq.ZIndex + 1
    whiteGrad.Parent = sq
    Instance.new("UIGradient", whiteGrad).Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })

    local blackGrad = Instance.new("Frame")
    blackGrad.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    blackGrad.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    blackGrad.BorderSizePixel = 0
    blackGrad.ZIndex = sq.ZIndex + 1
    blackGrad.Parent = sq
    Instance.new("UIGradient", blackGrad).Rotation = 0
    Instance.new("UIGradient", blackGrad).Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })

    local sqKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
    sqKnob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
    sqKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    sqKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    sqKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sqKnob.ZIndex = sq.ZIndex + 3
    sqKnob.Parent = sq
    Instance.new("UICorner", sqKnob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", sqKnob).Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", sqKnob).Transparency = 0.4

    -- Полоса оттенка
    local hueBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    hueBar.Name = "Hue"
    hueBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 12)
    hueBar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0, 1, -26)
    hueBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hueBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hueBar.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    hueBar.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", hueBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    -- Радуга
    local rainbow = Instance.new("Frame")
    rainbow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    rainbow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    rainbow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    rainbow.ZIndex = hueBar.ZIndex + 1
    rainbow.Parent = hueBar
    Instance.new("UIGradient", rainbow).Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(3 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
    })

    local hueKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
    hueKnob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 18)
    hueKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    hueKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hueKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hueKnob.ZIndex = hueBar.ZIndex + 3
    hueKnob.Parent = hueBar
    Instance.new("UICorner", hueKnob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        hexLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    end
    applyTheme()
    subscribe(frame, applyTheme)

    local function updateVisuals()
        color = Utils.hsvToColor(hsv.H, hsv.S, hsv.V)
        sq.BackgroundColor3 = Utils.hsvToColor(hsv.H, 1, 1)
        sqKnob.Position = UDim2.new(hsv.S, 0, 1 - hsv.V, 0)
        hueKnob.Position = UDim2.new(hsv.H, 0, 0.5, 0)
        preview.BackgroundColor3 = color
        hexLabel.Text = Utils.toHex(color)
    end

    local function setValue(newColor, fire)
        if typeof(newColor) ~= "Color3" then return end
        hsv = Utils.colorToHsv(newColor)
        color = newColor
        updateVisuals()
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = color end
        Config.ScheduleSave()
        if fire ~= false and config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, color) end
    end

    -- Перетаскивание по квадрату
    local function makeDraggable(target, onMove)
        local dragging = false
        local function move(pos)
            local size = target.AbsoluteSize
            if size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 then return end
            local x = Utils.clamp((pos.X - target.AbsolutePosition.X) / size.X, 0, 1)
            local y = Utils.clamp((pos.Y - target.AbsolutePosition.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
            onMove(x, y)
        end

        target.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
               or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                move(input.Position)
            end
        end)
        target.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
               or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                move(input.Position)
            end
        end)
        target.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
               or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end

    makeDraggable(sq, function(x, y)
        hsv.S = x
        hsv.V = 1 - y
        updateVisuals()
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = color end
        if config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, color) end
    end)

    makeDraggable(hueBar, function(x)
        hsv.H = x
        updateVisuals()
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = color end
        if config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, color) end
    end)

    updateVisuals()

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "ColorPicker",
        Flag = flag,
        Callback = config.Callback,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return color
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newColor)
        setValue(newColor, false)
    end
    function obj:GetHex()
        return Utils.toHex(color)
    end
    function obj:SetHex(hex)
        setValue(Utils.fromHex(hex), true)
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj)
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- PROGRESS
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateProgress({
        Name = "Загрузка",
        Default = 0.5,     -- 0..1
        Color = nil,       -- nil = Accent
        ShowText = true,
    })
    Позже: progress:Set(0.8)
]]
function Elements.Progress(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = config.Height or 34
    local value = Utils.clamp(config.Default or 0, 0, 1)

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Progress_" .. tostring(config.Name or "Progress")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Progress")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local percentLabel
    if config.ShowText ~= false then
        percentLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        percentLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 16)
        percentLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 4)
        percentLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        percentLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        percentLabel.TextSize = 10
        percentLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        percentLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        percentLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
        percentLabel.Parent = frame
    end

    local bar = Anim.ProgressBar(frame, 6, 0.35)
    bar.Fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0)
    bar.Fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 6)
    bar.Fill.Parent = frame
    bar.Fill.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
        if percentLabel then percentLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent") end
        if not config.Color then
            bar.Color(Theme.Get("Accent"))
        end
    end
    applyTheme()
    subscribe(frame, applyTheme)

    if config.Color then
        bar.Color(config.Color)
    end

    local function setValue(newValue, animate)
        value = Utils.clamp(newValue, 0, 1)
        if percentLabel then
            percentLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
        end
        if animate == false then
            bar.Instant(value)
        else
            bar.Set(value)
        end
        if config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value) end
    end

    setValue(value, false)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Progress",
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return value
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        setValue(newValue, true)
    end
    function obj:Instant(newValue)
        setValue(newValue, false)
    end
    function obj:SetColor(color)
        bar.Color(color)
    end

    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- PARAGRAPH (текст с переносом)
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateParagraph({
        Text = "Длинный текст...",
        Size = 11,
        Align = "left" | "center" | "right",
        Height = 60,
    })
]]
function Elements.Paragraph(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local text = tostring(config.Text or "")

    local align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    if config.Align == "center" then
        align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    elseif config.Align == "right" then
        align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    end

    local frame = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    frame.Name = "Paragraph"
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, config.Height or 60)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Text = text
    frame.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    frame.TextSize = config.Size or 11
    frame.Font = config.Font or Enum.Font.Gotham
    frame.TextXAlignment = align
    frame.TextYAlignment = config.YAlign or Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    frame.TextWrapped = true
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page

    subscribe(frame, function()
        frame.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    end)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Paragraph",
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return frame.Text
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newText)
        frame.Text = tostring(newText)
    end
    obj.Text = frame

    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

--[[
    tab:CreateSpacer(10)   — вертикальный отступ
    tab:CreateSpacer()     — разделительная линия
]]
function Elements.Spacer(page, size, line)
    local height = (type(size) == "number" and size > 0) and size or 10

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Spacer"
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page

    if line then
        local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
        rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 1)
        rule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, height / 2 - 0.5)
        rule.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Border")
        rule.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        rule.BorderSizePixel = 0
        rule.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
        rule.Parent = frame
        subscribe(frame, function()
            rule.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Border")

    local obj = {Frame = frame, Type = "Spacer"}

-- =====================================================================
-- ACCORDION (раскрывающиеся блоки)
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    local acc = tab:CreateAccordion({Name = "Расширенные"})
    acc:Add("Пункт 1", function(item)
        item:CreateToggle({Name = "Вложенный тумблер"})
    end)
]]
function Elements.Accordion(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local items = config.Items or {}

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Accordion"
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ClipsDescendants = true
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 34)
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = tostring(config.Name or "Accordion")
    title.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    title.TextSize = 11
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    title.Parent = frame

    local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 12)
    arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    arrow.Text = "▼"
    arrow.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    arrow.TextSize = 7
    arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    arrow.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    arrow.Parent = frame

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.AutoButtonColor = false
    hit.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    hit.Parent = frame

    local content = Instance.new("Frame")
    content.Name = "Content"
    content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    content.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    content.ClipsDescendants = true
    content.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    content.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UIListLayout", content).Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    Instance.new("UIPadding", content).PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    Instance.new("UIPadding", content).PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local expanded = false

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        title.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        arrow.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    end
    applyTheme()
    subscribe(frame, applyTheme)

    local function setExpanded(state)
        if expanded == state then return end
        expanded = state
        if state then
            content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, content.AbsoluteSize.Y)
            frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
            Motion.Frame(frame, 0.3, function(t)
                local target = 34 + content.AbsoluteSize.Y
                frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, (34 + (content.AbsoluteSize.Y)) * t + 34 * (1 - t))
            end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })
            frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        else
            frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
            local startH = frame.Size.Y.Offset
            local targetH = 34
            Motion.Frame(frame, 0.25, function(t)
                frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, startH + (targetH - startH) * t)
            end, {
                ease = Motion.EaseFn("inQuad"),
                onDone = function()
                    frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
                end,
            })
        end
        arrow.Text = state and "▲" or "▼"
    end

    hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setExpanded(not expanded)
    end)
    hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.02}, 0.15)
    end)
    hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}, 0.15)
    end)

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Accordion",
        Content = content,
        Items = items,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return expanded
    end
    function obj:SetValue(state)
        setExpanded(state and true or false)
    end
    function obj:Add(name, builder)
        -- Вложенный контейнер для элементов пункта
        local itemFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        itemFrame.Name = "Item_" .. tostring(name)
        itemFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        itemFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        itemFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        itemFrame.LayoutOrder = #items + 1
        itemFrame.ZIndex = content.ZIndex + 1
        itemFrame.Parent = content
        Instance.new("UIListLayout", itemFrame).Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
        Instance.new("UIPadding", itemFrame).PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)

        local itemHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        itemHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
        itemHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        itemHeader.Text = tostring(name)
        itemHeader.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        itemHeader.TextSize = 10
        itemHeader.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        itemHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        itemHeader.LayoutOrder = 0
        itemHeader.ZIndex = itemFrame.ZIndex + 1
        itemHeader.Parent = itemFrame

        local wrapper = {
            Frame = itemFrame,
            Name = tostring(name),
        }
        -- Проксируем методы Create* в контейнер пункта
        for _, method in ipairs({"CreateToggle", "CreateButton", "CreateSlider", "CreateDropdown", "CreateLabel", "CreateTextbox", "CreateKeybind", "CreateStepper", "CreateListbox", "CreateColorPicker", "CreateProgress", "CreateSection"}) do
            if Elements[method] then
                wrapper[method] = function(config2)
                    local el = Elements[method](itemFrame, config2)
                    el.Frame.Parent = itemFrame
                    return el
                end
            end
        end

        if builder then pcall(builder, wrapper) end
        table.insert(items, wrapper)
        return wrapper
    end

    -- Пре-рендер переданных пунктов
    if #items > 0 then
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            if type(item) == "table" and item.Name then
                obj:Add(item.Name, item.Builder)
            end
        end
    end

    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

-- =====================================================================
-- TOOLTIP
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    local btn = tab:CreateButton({Name = "?", Tooltip = "Что делает"})
]]
function Elements.AttachTooltip(guiObject, text, options)
    options = options or {}

    if guiObject:GetAttribute("AshTooltip") then
        return
    end
    guiObject:SetAttribute("AshTooltip", true)

    local tooltip = Instance.new("Frame")
    tooltip.Name = "Tooltip"
    tooltip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 40)
    tooltip.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Surface")
    tooltip.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    tooltip.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tooltip.Visible = false
    tooltip.ZIndex = 999999
    tooltip.Parent = options.Parent or guiObject
    Instance.new("UICorner", tooltip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", tooltip)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.4

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -12)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(text)
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 10
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    label.TextWrapped = true
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    label.ZIndex = tooltip.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = tooltip

    local hovering = false
    local visible = false

    local function show()
        if visible then return end
        visible = true
        tooltip.Visible = true
        local pos = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
        local size = guiObject.AbsoluteSize
        tooltip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y - tooltip.Size.Y.Offset - 4)
        tooltip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.TextTransparency = 1
        Motion.Frame(tooltip, 0.18, function(t)
            tooltip.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - t
            label.TextTransparency = 1 - t
        end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outQuad") })
    end

    local function hide()
        if not visible then return end
        visible = false
        Motion.Frame(tooltip, 0.15, function(t)
            tooltip.BackgroundTransparency = t
            label.TextTransparency = t
        end, {
            ease = Motion.EaseFn("inQuad"),
            onDone = function()
                tooltip.Visible = false
            end,
        })
    end

    guiObject.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        hovering = true
        task.delay(options.Delay or 0.35, function()
            if hovering then show() end
        end)
    end)
    guiObject.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        hovering = false
        hide()
    end)

    subscribe(tooltip, function()
        tooltip.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Surface")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    end)

    return tooltip
end

-- =====================================================================
-- CAMERA (FOV)
-- =====================================================================
--[[
    tab:CreateCamera({Name = "FOV", Default = 90, Min = 30, Max = 120, Flag = "FOV"})
    Плавно меняет FieldOfView камеры при включении элемента.
]]
function Elements.CameraFov(page, config)
    config = config or {}
    local height = 46
    local flag = config.Flag
    local defaultFov = config.Default or 90
    local minValue = config.Min or 30
    local maxValue = config.Max or 120
    local step = config.Step or 1

    local value = defaultFov
    if flag and not Registry.HasFlag(flag) then
        Registry.AddFlag(flag, value, config.Save)
    elseif flag then
        value = Registry.GetFlag(flag) or value
    end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "CameraFov"
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.LayoutOrder = orderCounter()
    frame.ZIndex = (page.ZIndex or 1) + 2
    frame.Parent = page
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = tostring(config.Name or "FOV")
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    label.Parent = frame

    local valueLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valueLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 16)
    valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 4)
    valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valueLabel.Text = tostring(value)
    valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    valueLabel.TextSize = 11
    valueLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valueLabel.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    valueLabel.Parent = frame

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 6)
    track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0, 1, -14)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
    track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
    track.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale((value - minValue) / (maxValue - minValue), 1)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
    fill.Parent = track
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
    hit.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0, 1, -24)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.AutoButtonColor = false
    hit.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 3
    hit.Parent = frame

    local function applyTheme()
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        valueLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        track.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Input")
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
    end
    applyTheme()
    subscribe(frame, applyTheme)

    local function setValue(newValue, fire)
        newValue = Utils.clamp(newValue, minValue, maxValue)
        newValue = Utils.roundTo(newValue, step)
        value = newValue
        valueLabel.Text = tostring(value)
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(Utils.clamp((value - minValue) / (maxValue - minValue), 0, 1), 1)
        if flag then Registry.Flags[flag] = value end

        -- Плавно меняем FOV
        if cam and cam.FieldOfView ~= value then
            Motion.Tween(cam, {FieldOfView = value}, 0.2, "quad", "out")
        end
        Config.ScheduleSave()
        if fire ~= false and config.Callback then pcall(config.Callback, value) end
    end

    local dragging = false
    hit.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function(input)
        dragging = true
        local size = track.AbsoluteSize.X
        if size > 0 then
            local ratio = Utils.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / size, 0, 1)
            setValue(minValue + ratio * (maxValue - minValue), true)
        end
    end)
    hit.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
           or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local size = track.AbsoluteSize.X
            if size <= 0 then return end
            local ratio = Utils.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / size, 0, 1)
            setValue(minValue + ratio * (maxValue - minValue), true)
        end
    end)
    hit.InputEnded:Connect(function() dragging = false end)

    -- Возвращаем FOV при выходе (страховка)
    if type(game) == "table" and game.Players then
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
        local ok = pcall(function()
            LocalPlayer.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
                if plr == LocalPlayer and cam then
                    cam.FieldOfView = 70
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local obj = {
        Frame = frame,
        Type = "Camera",
        Flag = flag,
        Min = minValue, Max = maxValue, Step = step,
    }
    function obj:GetValue()
        return value
    end
    function obj:SetValue(newValue)
        setValue(newValue, false)
    end
    function obj:Reset()
        setValue(defaultFov, true)
    end

    Registry.RegisterElement(flag or obj.Name, obj, "Sliders")
    attachToSection(obj)
    return obj
end

return Elements
end)()

--======================================================================
-- FILE: Window.lua -> Window  (require stripped: 9, returns Ash)
--======================================================================
local Window = (function()
--!nonstrict
--[[
    Ash UI v3.0 — Window
    Окно, вкладки, drag с инерцией, snap, minimize, hide по клавише,
    встроенная вкладка настроек и тост для уведомлений.

    API (совместим с v2):
        local window = Ash:CreateWindow({
            Title = "Ash", Version = "3.0", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(560, 440),
        })
        local tab = window:CreateTab({Name = "Main"})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "A", Callback = function(v) end})
        window:CreateSettingsTab()   -- вкладка настроек с темами/сохранением
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- ⚠ ПОРЯДОК ВАЖЕН: Config требует Registry/Theme/Utils, а Notify — Motion/Theme.
--   Elements и ElementsAdvanced подключаем ПОСЛЕ Config, иначе возникает
--   циклическая зависимость (Elements -> Config -> Registry).

-- Сливаем элементы из двух файлов в одну таблицу
for name, fn in pairs(Advanced) do
    if Elements[name] == nil and type(fn) == "function" then
        Elements[name] = fn
    end
end

local Ash = {}
Ash.__index = Ash
Ash.Windows = {}
Ash.Flags = Registry.Flags
Ash.Themes = Theme.Saved
Ash.GlobalSettings = {
    ThemeName = Theme.GetName(),
    Transparency = 0.0,
    OpenSpeed = 0.3,
    DragSmooth = 0.18,
    HideKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
    AccentOverride = nil,   -- если задать Color3 — переопределяет Accent темы
}

-- ============================================================
-- ХЕЛПЕРЫ
-- ============================================================
local function Create(class, props)
    local inst = Instance.new(class)
    if props then
        for k, v in pairs(props) do
            if k ~= "Parent" then
                local ok = pcall(function() inst[k] = v end)
                if not ok then
                    -- Некоторые свойства нельзя ставить до Parent (например ClipsDescendants)
                end
            end
        end
        if props.Parent then inst.Parent = props.Parent end
    end
    return inst
end

-- Акцент с учётом переопределения
local function Accent()
    local override = Ash.GlobalSettings.AccentOverride
    if override then return override end
    return Theme.Get("Accent")
end

local function GetGuiParent()
    -- gethui есть только в некоторых инжекторах; иначе PlayerGui
    if type(gethui) == "function" then
        local ok, hui = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and hui then return hui end
    end
    return Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Появление элемента: сдвиг снизу + прозрачность
local function applyStagger(frame, style)
    if not frame or not frame.Parent then return end
    if not frame:IsA("GuiObject") then return end

    local startX = frame.Position.X.Scale
    local startXS = frame.Position.X.Offset
    local startY = frame.Position.Y.Scale
    local startYO = frame.Position.Y.Offset + 12

    frame.Position = UDim2.new(startX, startXS, startY, startYO)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    Motion.Frame(frame, 0.3, function(t)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - t
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startX, startXS,
            startY, startYO + 12 * (1 - t)
        )
    end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn(style or "outCubic") })
end

-- ============================================================
-- ТЕМА ДЛЯ ВСЕХ ОКОН
-- ============================================================
function Ash:SetTheme(name, speed)
    if not Theme.Set(name, speed or 1) then
        return false
    end
    Ash.GlobalSettings.ThemeName = name
    return true
end

function Ash:GetTheme()
    return Theme.GetName()
end

-- Своя палитра
function Ash:RegisterTheme(name, palette)
    return Theme.Register(name, palette)
end

function Ash:GetThemes()
    return Theme.List()
end

-- ============================================================
-- ЗВЁЗДЫ / ЛУНА
-- ============================================================
local function buildMoon(parent, size)
    local moon = Anim.CreateMoon(parent, size or 240, {
        glow = true,
        craters = true,
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
    })
    if Ash.GlobalSettings.Stars ~= false then
        moon.Stars = Anim.CreateStars(parent, moon.Body, Ash.GlobalSettings.StarCount or 40, 1.8)
    end
    return moon
end

    local function syncShadow()
        Shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0, Main.Position.X.Offset - 16, 0, Main.Position.Y.Offset - 16)
        Shadow.Size = UDim2.new(0, Main.Size.X.Offset + 32, 0, Main.Size.Y.Offset + 32)

    -- ============================================================
    -- КОНТЕНТ

    })
    Create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 0),

        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Border"),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,

    })

    -- Шапка сайдбара
    local Logo = Create("TextLabel", {

        Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 6),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = string.upper(tostring(config.Logo or "Ash")),
        TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled"),
        TextSize = 9,

    local PageContainer = Create("Frame", {

        Position = UDim2.new(0, sidebarWidth, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 3,
        Parent = Container,
    })

    -- ============================================================
    -- ОБЪЕКТ ОКНА

        Gui = ScreenGui,
        Blocker = blocker,
        Main = Main,
        TitleBar = TitleBar,
        Sidebar = Sidebar,
        TabContainer = TabContainer,
        PageContainer = PageContainer,
        Tabs = {},
        ActiveTab = nil,
        Hidden = false,
        Minimized = false,
        OrigSize = size,
        Config = config,
        _refs = {
            Main = Main,
            MainStroke = MainStroke,
            Shadow = Shadow,
            Decor = Decor,
            TitleBar = TitleBar,
            TitleBarMask = TitleBar,
            TitleBorder = TitleBorder,
            IconFrame = IconFrame,
            IconCrater = IconCrater,
            TitleLabel = TitleLabel,
            VerLabel = VerLabel,
            UnameLabel = UnameLabel,
            UiLabel = UiLabel,
            Logo = Logo,
            MinimizeBtn = MinimizeBtn,
            MinimizeGlyph = MinimizeGlyph,
            CloseBtn = CloseBtn,
            cross1 = cross1,
            cross2 = cross2,
            Container = Container,
        },
    }
    setmetatable(Window, {__index = Ash})

    -- Запоминаем элементы декора для destroy
    Window._Moon = Moon
    Window._Aurora = Aurora

    -- ============================================================
    -- DRAG (с инерцией и snap)
    -- ============================================================
    local dragController = Motion.MakeDraggable(Main, {
        smoothness = Ash.GlobalSettings.DragSmooth or 0.18,
        friction = 0.86,
        snap = true,
        snapSpeed = 0.25,
        boundsOffset = 10,
        handles = { TitleBar },
    })
    Window._drag = dragController

    -- ============================================================
    -- ТЕМА ДЛЯ ЭТОГО ОКНА
    -- ============================================================
    local function applyWindowTheme()
        Main.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Background")
        Main.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - (Ash.GlobalSettings.Transparency or 0))
        MainStroke.Color = Theme.Get("Border")
        Shadow.ImageColor3 = Theme.Get("Shadow")

        TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TitleBar")
        TitleBarMask.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TitleBar")
        TitleBorder.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Border")

        IconFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Accent()
        IconCrater.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")

        TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        if VerLabel then VerLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled") end

        Logo.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
        UnameLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
        UiLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDisabled")
        UserInfo.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")

        Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Surface")
        MinimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        MinimizeGlyph.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")
        cross1.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        cross2.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")

        -- Обновляем вкладки
        for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
            if tab.ApplyTheme then pcall(tab.ApplyTheme, tab) end
        end
    end
    Window._applyTheme = applyWindowTheme

    Theme.OnChange(function()
        if Main.Parent then
            applyWindowTheme()
        end
    end)

    applyWindowTheme()

    -- ============================================================
    -- ВКЛАДКИ
    -- ============================================================

    --[[
        window:CreateTab({Name = "Main", Icon = "⚙"})
    ]]
    function Window:CreateTab(tabConfig)
        tabConfig = tabConfig or {}
        local tabName = tabConfig.Name or "Tab"

        local TabBtn = Create("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Background"),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            LayoutOrder = #self.Tabs + 1,
            ZIndex = 5,
            Parent = self.TabContainer,
        })
        Create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6), Parent = TabBtn})

        local Indicator = Create("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -8),
            BackgroundColor3 = Accent(),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 7,
            Parent = TabBtn,
        })
        Create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2), Parent = Indicator})

        local TabIcon
        if tabConfig.Icon then
            TabIcon = Create("TextLabel", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -7),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = tabConfig.Icon,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim"),
                TextSize = 10,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                ZIndex = 7,
                Parent = TabBtn,
            })
        end

        local TabLabel = Create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -(TabIcon and 28 or 14), 1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, TabIcon and 26 or 14, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = tostring(tabName),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim"),
            TextSize = 11,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 7,
            Parent = TabBtn,
        })

        local Page = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16),
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = 3,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim"),
            ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 4,
            Parent = self.PageContainer,
        })
        Create("UIListLayout", {
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Parent = Page,
        })
        Create("UIPadding", {
            PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 16),
            PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6),
            Parent = Page,
        })

        local tab = {
            Name = tostring(tabName),
            Button = TabBtn,
            Page = Page,
            Indicator = Indicator,
            Label = TabLabel,
            Icon = TabIcon,
            Window = self,
            Elements = {},
        }

        -- Проксируем методы создания элементов
        local methods = {
            "CreateSection", "CreateLabel", "CreateButton", "CreateToggle",
            "CreateTextbox", "CreateKeybind", "CreateStepper", "CreateSlider",
            "CreateDropdown", "CreateListbox", "CreateColorPicker",
            "CreateProgress", "CreateParagraph", "CreateSpacer",
            "CreateAccordion", "CreateCamera", "AttachTooltip",
        }
        for _, method in ipairs(methods) do
            if Elements[method] then
                tab[method] = function(elementConfig)
                    local element = Elements[method](Page, elementConfig)
                    if element and element.Frame then
                        table.insert(tab.Elements, element)
                        -- Плавное появление элемента
                        if Ash.GlobalSettings.Stagger ~= false then
                            applyStagger(element.Frame)
                        end
                        -- Tooltip: если передан в конфиге элемента
                        if elementConfig and elementConfig.Tooltip then
                            Elements.AttachTooltip(element.Frame, elementConfig.Tooltip)
                        end
                    end
                    return element
                end
            end
        end

        -- Удобные алиасы
        tab.CreateInput = tab.CreateTextbox
        tab.CreateBox = tab.CreateTextbox
        tab.CreateSelect = tab.CreateDropdown
        tab.CreateColor = tab.CreateColorPicker
        tab.CreateFov = tab.CreateCamera

        -- Автосворачиваемый section
        tab.CreateCollapsibleSection = function(sectionConfig)
            sectionConfig = sectionConfig or {}
            local section = tab:CreateSection(sectionConfig)
            section.Collapsible = true
            return section
        end

        function tab:ApplyTheme()
            TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Background")
            TabLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
            Indicator.BackgroundColor3 = Accent()
            if TabIcon then TabIcon.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim") end
            Page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
        end

        TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            self:SelectTab(tab)
        end)
        TabBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if self.ActiveTab ~= tab then
                Motion.Tween(TabBtn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.85}, 0.15)
            end
        end)
        TabBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if self.ActiveTab ~= tab then
                Motion.Tween(TabBtn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, 0.15)
            end
        end)

        table.insert(self.Tabs, tab)
        if #self.Tabs == 1 then
            self:SelectTab(tab)
        end
        return tab
    end

    --[[
        Переключение вкладки с анимацией.
    ]]
    function Window:SelectTab(tab)
        if not tab or self.ActiveTab == tab then return end

        local previous = self.ActiveTab
        self.ActiveTab = tab

        for _, t in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            if t == tab then
                t.Indicator.Visible = true
                t.Label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("Text")
                t.Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
                if t.Icon then t.Icon.TextColor3 = Accent() end
            else
                t.Indicator.Visible = false
                t.Label.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
                t.Button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                if t.Icon then t.Icon.TextColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim") end
            end
        end

        if previous then
            previous.Page.Visible = false
        end

        -- Появление страницы: сдвиг + прозрачность + stagger элементов
        tab.Page.Visible = true
        tab.Page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 8)
        tab.Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        Motion.Frame(tab.Page, 0.25, function(t)
            tab.Page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8 + 10 * (1 - t), 8)
            tab.Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - t
        end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })

        -- Индикатор выезжает
        if tab.Indicator.Visible then
            local startH = 0
            Motion.Frame(tab.Indicator, 0.25, function(t)
                tab.Indicator.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 16 * t)
            end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })
        end

        return tab
    end

    -- Получить вкладку по имени
    function Window:GetTab(name)
        for _, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            if tab.Name == name then return tab end
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- Удалить вкладку
    function Window:RemoveTab(name)
        local index
        for i, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            if tab.Name == name then index = i break end
        end
        if not index then return false end

        local tab = table.remove(self.Tabs, index)
        for i, other in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            other.Button.LayoutOrder = i
        end
        if tab.Button then tab.Button:Destroy() end
        if tab.Page then tab.Page:Destroy() end
        if self.ActiveTab == tab then
            self.ActiveTab = nil
            if self.Tabs[1] then self:SelectTab(self.Tabs[1]) end
        end
        return true
    end

    -- Переименовать вкладку
    function Window:RenameTab(oldName, newName)
        local tab = self:GetTab(oldName)
        if not tab then return false end
        tab.Name = tostring(newName)
        tab.Label.Text = tab.Name
        return true
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- ВКЛАДКА НАСТРОЕК
    -- ============================================================

    --[[
        window:CreateSettingsTab() — добавляет вкладку с:
        * выбором темы
        * сохранением/загрузкой/сбросом конфига
        * включением-выключением звёзд и авроры
        * переключателем прозрачности
    ]]
    function Window:CreateSettingsTab()
        local tab = self:CreateTab({Name = "Settings", Icon = "⚙"})

        tab:CreateSection("Theme")
        tab:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Palette",
            Options = Theme.List(),
            Default = (function()
                for i, name in ipairs(Theme.List()) do
                    if name == Theme.GetName() then return i end
                end
                return 1
            end)(),
            Flag = "Ash_Theme",
            Callback = function(value)
                if value and Theme.Saved[value] then
                    Theme.Set(value)
                    Ash.GlobalSettings.ThemeName = value
                end
            end,
        })

        tab:CreateLabel("Тема применяется ко всем окнам и сохраняется в конфиг.", {
            Size = 9,
        })

        tab:CreateSection("Appearance")
        tab:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Stars",
            Default = Ash.GlobalSettings.Stars ~= false,
            Flag = "Ash_Stars",
            Save = false,
            Callback = function(v)
                Ash.GlobalSettings.Stars = v
                if Window._Moon and Window._Moon.Stars then
                    Window._Moon.Stars.Container.Visible = v
                end
            end,
        })
        tab:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Aurora",
            Default = Ash.GlobalSettings.Aurora ~= false,
            Flag = "Ash_Aurora",
            Save = false,
            Callback = function(v)
                Ash.GlobalSettings.Aurora = v
                if Window._Aurora then
                    Window._Aurora.Layer.Visible = v
                end
            end,
        })
        tab:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Stagger animation",
            Default = Ash.GlobalSettings.Stagger ~= false,
            Flag = "Ash_Stagger",
            Save = false,
            Callback = function(v)
                Ash.GlobalSettings.Stagger = v
            end,
        })
        tab:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Drag smoothness",
            Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = Ash.GlobalSettings.DragSmooth or 0.18,
            Step = 0.01, Suffix = "",
            Flag = "Ash_DragSmooth",
            Callback = function(v)
                Ash.GlobalSettings.DragSmooth = v
                if Window._drag then
                    Window._drag.Disable()
                    Window._drag = Motion.MakeDraggable(Main, {
                        smoothness = v, friction = 0.86, snap = true,
                        snapSpeed = 0.25, boundsOffset = 10, handles = { TitleBar },
                    })
                end
            end,
        })
        tab:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Window transparency",
            Min = 0, Max = 0.6, Default = Ash.GlobalSettings.Transparency or 0,
            Step = 0.01,
            Flag = "Ash_Transparency",
            Callback = function(v)
                Ash.GlobalSettings.Transparency = v
                Motion.Tween(Main, {BackgroundTransparency = v}, 0.2)
            end,
        })

        tab:CreateSection("Keybind")
        tab:CreateKeybind({
            Name = "Hide/show window",
            Default = Ash.GlobalSettings.HideKey,
            Flag = "Ash_HideKey",
            Mode = "Toggle",
            Callback = function(key)
                if key and key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    Ash.GlobalSettings.HideKey = key
                end
            end,
        })

        tab:CreateSection("Config")
        tab:CreateButton({
            Name = "Save settings",
            Style = "Accent",
            Callback = function()
                Config.Save()
                Notify:Success("Сохранено", "Настройки записаны в " .. tostring(Config.FileName))
            end,
        })
        tab:CreateButton({
            Name = "Load settings",
            Callback = function()
                if Config.Load() then
                    Config.ApplyToElements()
                    Notify:Success("Загружено", "Настройки применены")
                else
                    Notify:Warning("Нет конфига", "Файл не найден или повреждён")
                end
            end,
        })
        tab:CreateButton({
            Name = "Reset settings",
            Style = "Danger",
            Callback = function()
                Config.Delete()
                Notify:Info("Сброшено", "Файл конфига удалён")
            end,
        })
        tab:CreateButton({
            Name = "Copy theme preset",
            Callback = function()
                local code = Config.ExportCode()
                if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
                    pcall(setclipboard, code)
                    Notify:Success("Скопировано", "Пресет в буфере обмена")
                else
                    print(code)
                    Notify:Info("Пресет", "setclipboard недоступен — код в консоли")
                end
            end,
        })

        -- Применить сохранённые значения к элементам
        task.defer(function()
            if Registry.GetFlag("Ash_Stars") == false then
                if Window._Moon and Window._Moon.Stars then
                    Window._Moon.Stars.Container.Visible = false
                end
            end
            if Registry.GetFlag("Ash_Aurora") == false and Window._Aurora then
                Window._Aurora.Layer.Visible = false
            end
            local storedTheme = Registry.GetFlag("Ash_Theme")
            if storedTheme and Theme.Saved[storedTheme] then
                Theme.Set(storedTheme)
            end
        end)

        return tab
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- КНОПКИ TITLE BAR
    -- ============================================================
    MinimizeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(MinimizeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceHover")}, 0.15)
        MinimizeGlyph.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Accent")
    end)
    MinimizeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(MinimizeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")}, 0.15)
        MinimizeGlyph.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")
    end)
    CloseBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(CloseBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("Danger")}, 0.15)
        Motion.Tween(cross1, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("AccentText")}, 0.15)
        Motion.Tween(cross2, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("AccentText")}, 0.15)
    end)
    CloseBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Motion.Tween(CloseBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("SurfaceLight")}, 0.15)
        Motion.Tween(cross1, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")}, 0.15)
        Motion.Tween(cross2, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Get("TextDim")}, 0.15)
    end)

    -- Свернуть
    function Window:Minimize()
        if self.Minimized then return end
        self.Minimized = true

        -- Запоминаем позицию, чтобы вернуть на место
        self._minPos = Main.Position

        Motion.Frame(Main, 0.25, function(t)
            Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X.Offset * (1 - t), 0, size.Y.Offset * (1 - t))
            Main.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - t + t * 0.3
        end, {
            ease = Motion.EaseFn("inBack"),
            onDone = function()
                Main.Visible = false
            end,
        })
    end

    function Window:Restore()
        if not self.Minimized then return end
        self.Minimized = false
        Main.Visible = true
        Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        Motion.Frame(Main, 0.3, function(t)
            Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X.Offset * t, 0, size.Y.Offset * t)
            Main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 * (1 - t)
        end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outBack", 1.1) })
    end

    MinimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if self.Minimized then
            self:Restore()
        else
            self:Minimize()
        end
    end)

    -- Закрыть/открыть
    function Window:Hide()
        if self.Hidden then return end
        self.Hidden = true
        blocker.Visible = false
        if self._drag then self._drag.Disable() end
        local startPos = Main.AbsolutePosition
        Motion.Frame(Main, 0.25, function(t)
            Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X.Offset * (1 - t), 0, size.Y.Offset * (1 - t))
            Main.BackgroundTransparency = t
        end, {
            ease = Motion.EaseFn("inQuad"),
            onDone = function()
                Main.Visible = false
            end,
        })
    end

    function Window:Show()
        if not self.Hidden then return end
        self.Hidden = false
        blocker.Visible = true
        Main.Visible = true
        Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        Motion.Frame(Main, Ash.GlobalSettings.OpenSpeed or 0.3, function(t)
            local eased = t
            Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X.Offset * eased, 0, size.Y.Offset * eased)
            Main.BackgroundTransparency = (1 - eased) * 0.6
        end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outBack", 1.1) })
        if self._drag then self._drag.Enable() end
    end

    function Window:Toggle()
        if self.Hidden then
            self:Show()
        else
            self:Hide()
        end
    end

    function Window:IsHidden()
        return self.Hidden
    end

    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        self:Toggle()
    end)

    -- ============================================================
    -- HIDE KEY
    -- ============================================================
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if processed then return end
        local key = Ash.GlobalSettings.HideKey
        if key == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
        -- Игнорируем ввод, когда пользователь печатает в TextBox
        if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.KeyCode == key then
            self:Toggle()
        end
    end)

    -- ============================================================
    -- РАЗМЕР ОКНА
    -- ============================================================

    --[[
        Изменить размер окна (анимированно).
        window:SetSize(UDim2.new(0, 600, 0, 500))
    ]]
    function Window:SetSize(newSize)
        if type(newSize) ~= "UDim2" then return false end
        local fromX = Main.Size.X.Offset
        local fromY = Main.Size.Y.Offset
        local toX = newSize.X.Offset or fromX
        local toY = newSize.Y.Offset or fromY

        Motion.Frame(Main, 0.25, function(t)
            Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, fromX + (toX - fromX) * t, 0, fromY + (toY - fromY) * t)
        end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })

        size = UDim2.new(0, toX, 0, toY)
        self.OrigSize = size
        return true
    end

    function Window:GetSize()
        return Main.Size
    end

    -- Центрировать на экране (анимированно)
    function Window:Center(duration)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        local startX = Main.AbsolutePosition.X
        local startY = Main.AbsolutePosition.Y
        local targetX = (vp.X - Main.Size.X.Offset) / 2
        local targetY = (vp.Y - Main.Size.Y.Offset) / 2

        Motion.Frame(Main, duration or 0.3, function(t)
            Main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                startX + (targetX - startX) * t,
                startY + (targetY - startY) * t
            )
        end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outCubic") })
        return true
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- УНИЧТОЖЕНИЕ
    -- ============================================================
    function Window:Destroy()
        if self._drag then self._drag.Disable() end
        if self._Moon and self._Moon.Destroy then self._Moon:Destroy() end
        if self._Aurora and self._Aurora.Destroy then self._Aurora:Destroy() end
        for i = #Ash.Windows, 1, -1 do
            if Ash.Windows[i] == self then
                table.remove(Ash.Windows, i)
            end
        end
        if ScreenGui then
            ScreenGui:Destroy()
        end
        return true
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- РЕГИСТРАЦИЯ И ПОЯВЛЕНИЕ
    -- ============================================================
    table.insert(Ash.Windows, self)
    Ash.ActiveWindow = self

    -- Появление окна
    Main.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    Main.Visible = true

    task.spawn(function()
        Motion.Frame(Main, openSpeed, function(t)
            Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X.Offset * t, 0, size.Y.Offset * t)
            Main.BackgroundTransparency = (1 - t) * (Ash.GlobalSettings.Transparency or 0)
        end, { ease = Motion.EaseFn("outBack", 1.15) })
    end)

    return self
end

-- ============================================================
-- ПУБЛИЧНЫЕ ХЕЛПЕРЫ
-- ============================================================

-- Все окна
function Ash:GetWindows()
    return Ash.Windows
end

function Ash:GetWindow(name)
    for _, window in ipairs(Ash.Windows) do
        if window.Config and window.Config.Title == name then
            return window
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Глобальный переключатель окон
function Ash:ToggleAll()
    for _, window in ipairs(Ash.Windows) do
        window:Toggle()
    end
    return true
end

--[[
    Уведомления доступны как Ash:Notify({...})
]]
function Ash:Notify(options)
    return Notify:New(options)
end

Ash.Notify = Notify
Ash.Config = Config
Ash.Registry = Registry
Ash.Theme = Theme
Ash.Utils = Utils
Ash.Motion = Motion
Ash.Anim = Anim
Ash.Elements = Elements

-- Загрузка конфига при старте (мягко — если файла нет, просто ничего не делаем)
task.spawn(function()
    local loaded = false
    local ok = pcall(function()
        loaded = Config.Load()
    end)
    if ok and loaded then
        Config.ApplyToElements()
    end
end)

return Ash
end)()

--!nonstrict
--[[
    ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
    ║                Ash UI v3.0 — Lunar Edition                    ║
    ║                 GUI-библиотека для Roblox                      ║
    ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

    БЫСТРЫЙ СТАРТ
    ---------------------------------------------------------------
    Скопируй этот файл в свой инжектор, выполни — и всё готово:

        local Ash = loadstring(readfile("путь/к/Load.lua"))()

        local window = Ash:CreateWindow({Title = "Ash", Version = "3.0"})
        local tab = window:CreateTab({Name = "Main"})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Функция", Callback = function(v) end})

    Если инжектор не умеет readfile — укажи папку вручную:

        local Ash = require(script.Folder.ash.Window)

    СТРУКТУРА
    ---------------------------------------------------------------
        Load.lua              точка входа (этот файл)
        Window.lua            окна, вкладки, drag, настройки
        Elements.lua          базовые элементы
        ElementsAdvanced.lua  слайдеры, списки, пикеры, аккордеоны
        Theme.lua             палитры + плавные переходы
        Motion.lua            твины, пружины, инерция, snap
        Anim.lua              луна, звёзды, аврора, прогресс-бар
        Config.lua            сохранение настроек (CRC + base64)
        Registry.lua          реестр флагов и элементов
        Notify.lua            всплывающие уведомления
        Utils.lua             утилиты (цвет, числа, строки)

    СОВМЕСТИМОСТЬ API С v2
    ---------------------------------------------------------------
        Ash:CreateWindow, window:CreateTab
        CreateSection / CreateLabel / CreateButton / CreateToggle
        CreateTextbox / CreateKeybind / CreateStepper / CreateSlider
        CreateDropdown / CreateListbox / CreateColorPicker
        CreateProgress / CreateParagraph / CreateSpacer / CreateAccordion
        CreateCamera
        Ash:SetTheme, Ash:Notify, window:Show / Hide / Toggle / Destroy
]]

-- ============================================================
-- ЗАГРУЗКА МОДУЛЕЙ
-- ============================================================


-- Сливаем расширенные элементы
for name, fn in pairs(Advanced) do
    if Elements[name] == nil and type(fn) == "function" then
        Elements[name] = fn
    end
end

local Ash = Window

-- ============================================================
-- ГЛОБАЛЫЕ ДЛЯ СКРИПТОВ
-- ============================================================
if type(getgenv) == "function" then
    getgenv().Ash = Ash
end
_G.ASH = Ash

-- ============================================================
-- ХЕЛПЕРЫ ДЛЯ САМОГО ИНЖЕКТОРА
-- ============================================================

--[[
    Создать окно одной строкой:
        local w = Ash:Quick("Имя", {Tabs = {...}})
]]
function Ash:Quick(title, options)
    options = options or {}
    local window = self:CreateWindow({
        Title = title or "Ash",
        Version = options.Version or "3.0",
        Size = options.Size or UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 440),
        HideKey = options.HideKey or Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
    })
    if options.SettingsTab ~= false then
        window:CreateSettingsTab()
    end
    for _, tabConfig in ipairs(options.Tabs or {}) do
        local tab = window:CreateTab(tabConfig)
        if tabConfig.Build then
            tabConfig.Build(tab, window)
        end
    end
    return window
end

--[[
    Получить флаг по имени (nil-safe):
        if Ash:Get("Aimbot") then ... end
]]
function Ash:Get(flagName, defaultValue)
    local value = Registry.GetFlag(flagName)
    if value == nil then return defaultValue end
    return value
end

--[[
    Установить флаг (и вызвать колбэк элемента):
        Ash:Set("Aimbot", true)
]]
function Ash:Set(flagName, value)
    Registry.SetFlagAndFire(flagName, value)
    return true
end

-- Экспорт всех настроек строкой (для отладки и пресетов)
function Ash:Export()
    return Config.ExportCode()
end

-- Загрузка пресета из таблицы
function Ash:Import(preset)
    if type(preset) ~= "table" then return false end
    for flagName, value in pairs(preset) do
        if Registry.HasFlag(flagName) then
            Registry.SetFlagAndFire(flagName, value)
        end
    end
    Config.ScheduleSave()
    return true
end

-- Полный дамп настроек
function Ash:Dump()
    print(Config.Dump())
    return Config.Dump()
end

-- ============================================================
-- ПРИВЕТСТВИЕ
-- ============================================================
if not (getgenv and getgenv().__ASH_LOADED__) then
    if getgenv then getgenv().__ASH_LOADED__ = true end

    task.defer(function()
        Notify:New({
            Title = "Ash UI v3.0",
            Message = "Загружено · ПКМ по окну — закрыть · " .. tostring(Theme.GetName()),
            Duration = 4,
            Icon = "✓",
            Color = Theme.Get("Accent"),
        })
    end)
end

return Ash
